settings.title: Why Most SEO Investments Burn Cash Without Moving Rankings

settings.html:
Cheap packages that pile on backlinks from spam sites and call it a strategy.

Monthly keyword reports with no action. Rankings drift while the invoice arrives.

No page architecture. One service page trying to rank for 50 keywords at once.

That's not how we do SEO.

Keyword Fan-Out Architecture

We map every keyword variation, search intent and location modifier, then build a page for each one.

On-Page SEO

Titles, headings, content and structure tuned to rank. Every page optimised before we move to the next.

Technical SEO

Speed, crawlability, schema markup, Core Web Vitals and structured data. The foundation everything else sits on.

Content Production

SEO-optimised service pages, location pages and blog posts written by us, based on what your competitors are missing.

Link Building

Quality backlinks from South African sites, built by hand. No spam directories, no link farms.

Monthly Reporting

Clear reports on rankings, traffic, what we did and what comes next. No smoke, no mirrors.

We map your seed keywords into every variation: informational, commercial, transactional, location and problem-based. One seed keyword typically fans out into 15 to 30 pages.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How long does SEO actually take?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Local rankings often move within 2 to 3 months. Competitive terms take 4 to 6 months to reach the top of page one, and 9 to 12 months to truly dominate. Anyone promising page one in 30 days is either guessing or using tactics that get sites penalised. We set realistic timelines upfront and report progress every month.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What is the difference between SEO and Google Ads?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Google Ads buys instant visibility and stops the moment you stop paying. SEO builds organic rankings that compound and keep working. Ads are the fastest way to start. SEO lowers your long-term cost per lead. Most growing businesses run Ads first for immediate leads, then layer SEO so they are not renting all their traffic forever.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What is keyword fan-out and why does it matter?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: One seed keyword, "greenhouse tunnels", fans out into dozens of searches: "greenhouse tunnel installation Pretoria", "how much does a greenhouse tunnel cost", "greenhouse tunnel repair near me". Each is a different person at a different stage of buying. We build a page for each one instead of cramming them all onto one page.

No honest SEO can guarantee a specific position, because Google controls the algorithm. Anyone who guarantees page one is a red flag. What we guarantee is real strategy, transparent reporting and steady, compounding progress on the keywords that bring you customers.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How are you different from cheaper agencies?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Cheap packages usually mean spam backlinks and automated reports with no real action, which can get your site penalised. We do manual, white-hat work: real technical fixes, genuine content and quality South African backlinks built by outreach. You see exactly what we do each month, and you own every asset.

You keep everything we built: the on-page work, the content, the technical fixes and the rankings they earned. Rankings may soften over time without ongoing work as competitors keep pushing, but nothing is taken away when you leave.
